dedupe_keys.name: reproducibility repository for three dimensional modeling of deep borehole heat exchanger arrays

description: Collin Wittenstein publishes Julia experiment configurations and analysis scripts for deep-borehole heat-exchanger arrays. The Zenodo release and linked repository are free under the MIT licence. Scripts reproduce literature-comparison cases, depth scaling and array-spacing studies using GeothermalWells.jl 0.3.1 with pinned environments. The workflow separates simulations from figure generation using the deposited JLD2 outputs. It can support design comparisons and numerical verification of geothermal array models. Related G6 records model-geothermalwells-julia and data-deep-borehole-heat-array-temperature-benchmarks describe the reusable solver and saved outputs. Coverage is thesis benchmark cases; parameters require adaptation for another site. Julia 1.12 or newer is documented, and the complete run is reported to require roughly five hundred NVIDIA H200 GPU-hours. Some convergence figures default to stored error values, not new calculations. Runtime, numerical accuracy and backend compatibility remain unverified. Nothing was installed or executed.
